DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terrors (Sleep Terrors)

Based on your description of waking from deep sleep, intense fear without confusion, and the ability to be consoled shortly after, this pattern is highly characteristic of night terrors rather than nightmares or sleep apnea. We do not need further testing, but I will recommend establishing a strict sleep schedule and ensuring a safe sleep environment. Please monitor if these episodes increase in frequency or if you notice any daytime lethargy, and follow up if symptoms persist.
